decision.question: How should the failed reference deployment be recovered? Cosmos could not allocate the confirmed zone-redundant account in East US 2, and Basic ACR rejected a virtual network rule. The previously partially created resource group is now absent. Choose to retain the reliability design pending a regional capacity/access request, revise deployment preparation to evaluate a supported alternative and registry correction, or keep the reference local only.
decision.reason: The prior shared-infrastructure authorization explicitly requires stopping on new capacity/provider failures. Free-text continuation is not authorization to recreate the absent target, weaken zone redundancy, change region/SKU, or bypass the registry provider error. Azure directs Cosmos regional access requests to https://aka.ms/cosmosdbquota. Revised designs/targets require their applicable design review, fresh scoped what-if/cost evidence and deployment consent; no recovery choice itself claims capacity or deployment success.
choices: Retain zone redundancy; arrange East US 2 capacity access before retry preparation
